payload.name: Windows bug scan
payload.description: Scan the entire PinedIn codebase for bugs and platform-compatibility issues before publishing as a SaaS product. Known symptoms: (1) the EdgePeek (slide) feature does not expand when clicked on Windows, (2) the app crashes on Windows. Linux runs fine. Need a full scan — UI bugs, Tauri/Rust backend bugs, Windows-specific paths/permissions, webview2 quirks, file path handling (backslash vs forward slash), line-ending issues, native deps for WebView2, updater/sign-on-Windows quirks, IPC errors, and any other latent bugs that could break a SaaS release. Deliverable is a prioritised findings report with file:line evidence and recommended fixes; user will decide what to implement.
